# Sendput Complete Context Feed

Canonical URL: https://sendput.com/
Platform Class: Autonomous Information Routing & Generative Web Telemetry
Motto: Send information. Put it where it works.

## Executive Summary

Sendput is a specialized telemetry and generative engine optimization (GEO/AEO) architecture engineered to solve modern web observability and AI search visibility. The name Sendput represents the operational lifecycle of digital data: capturing information at runtime, routing it across execution boundaries, and putting it directly where it produces computational value.

## Architectural Pillars

### 1. Zero-Dependency Client Telemetry Beacon
- Single lightweight JavaScript SDK (beacon.js) under 5KB uncompressed.
- Native capture of window.onerror and unhandledrejection events with full stack traces.
- Real-time Core Web Vitals profiling: TTFB, DOMContentLoaded, Load, and First Contentful Paint (FCP).
- Transparent monkey-patching of window.fetch to isolate degraded 4xx/5xx responses and connection drops.
- Asynchronous dispatch via navigator.sendBeacon with automatic fallback to keepalive HTTP POST.

### 2. High-Throughput SQLite WAL Ingestion Daemon
- Zero-external-dependency Node.js HTTP server.
- High-concurrency persistence using SQLite with Write-Ahead Logging (PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL).
- Multi-tenant site partitioning indexing events, crawl audits, synthesized schemas, and model probe logs.
- Dedicated monitoring console serving real-time event tables, error counts, and latency statistics.

### 3. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & AEO Engine
- Automated transformation of dynamic Single Page Applications (SPAs) into machine-readable /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt feeds.
- Schema.org structured data synthesis dynamically extracting WebSite, Organization, SoftwareApplication, and FAQPage graphs.
- Multi-model brand citation tracking running targeted queries across Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, and Perplexity.
- Quantitative scoring: Share of Model Voice (SoMV), Domain Citation Frequency, average citation rank, competitor visibility, and hallucination alerts.

## Technical Specifications & Integration

### Beacon Injection
```html
<script src="https://sendput.com/telemetry/beacon.js"
  data-site-id="sendput.com"
  data-endpoint="/api/v1/telemetry/beacon"
  async>
</script>
```

### Agent Ingestion Header
```html
<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" href="https://sendput.com/llms.txt" title="Sendput Agent Feed">
```
